title: Black Friday ads start this week, not on Friday
direction: Fun, high-energy Instagram skit. Aman: friendly marketing expert, excited, warm, confident. Riya: Indian English, expressive online-shop owner who leaves everything to the last minute; breezy, then worried, then relieved. Fast natural back-and-forth with real reactions.

countdown.note: Black Friday, Fri 27 Nov 2026. {days} is computed when voice.py runs (REEL_DAYS=n overrides). Not spoken.

lines.say: Launch your Black Friday ad on Black Friday, and you're already late.
lines.show: Launch your Black Friday ad [on Black Friday], and you're [already late].

lines.say: Late? I always make my ads the night before!
lines.show: Late? I always make my ads the [night before]!

sections.label: 2 THINGS NEED TIME
sections.source: Meta ad standards: review is "typically completed within 24 hours, although it may take longer" · timeline is an illustration

lines.say: First, Meta reviews every ad. Usually a day. Sometimes longer.
lines.show: First, Meta [reviews every ad]. Usually a day. Sometimes [longer].

lines.say: Then the system needs days to learn who actually buys.
lines.show: Then the system needs [days to learn] who actually buys.

lines.say: So on Black Friday, my ad is still learning?
lines.show: So on Black Friday, my ad is [still learning]?!

lines.say: It's like hiring a new salesman the morning of your biggest sale.
lines.show: It's like hiring a [new salesman] the morning of your [biggest sale].

lines.say: He won't even know where the billing counter is!
lines.show: He won't even know where the [billing counter] is!

sections.label: DO THIS INSTEAD
sections.source: Meta's holiday guide: launch early so learning finishes before the peak · timeline is an illustration

lines.say: So launch this week. Small budget. Let it learn early.
lines.show: So [launch this week]. Small budget. Let it [learn early].

lines.say: And if Meta rejects my ad?
Then you still have time to fix it. That's the point!
lines.show: Then you still have [time to fix it]. That's the point!

lines.say: Comment FRIDAY. I'll send a day-by-day launch checklist.
lines.show: Comment ["FRIDAY"]. I'll send a day-by-day [launch checklist].

lines.say: Making my ad tonight. Not the night before!
lines.show: Making my ad [tonight]. Not the night before! 😎

items.share: Send this to the friend who does everything last minute 😅
